releases.name: v1.0.0
releases.body:
The first release for Freelens 2. The extension is ported to the Freelens v2 extension API and requires **Freelens >= 2.0.0**. On Freelens 1.x, keep using [v0.2.2](https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/releases/tag/v0.2.2).

## Highlights

- **Freelens 2 support.** The Overview page, the list pages and the details panels of every kind are adapted to the v2 extension API. A page opened before the cluster has loaded the CRDs now shows its objects once they are loaded, instead of staying on "not installed".
- **XBackend.** The experimental `gateway.networking.x-k8s.io/v1alpha1` `XBackend` kind has a "Backends" list page, a details panel and a chart on the Overview.
- **Clickable HTTPRoute hostnames.** The HTTPRoute list has a "Routes" column that links each hostname and path, with the scheme taken from the matching HTTP or HTTPS listeners of the parent Gateways.
- **Reference links by group and kind.** Backend, parent and target references, CA certificate references, parameters references and secret references link to the object of their own group and kind, in the version the cluster serves, and show only the name when the cluster serves no such kind. The core group is shown as `-`.
- **One sidebar entry per kind.** While the extension is enabled, the Gateway API kinds are left out of the Custom Resources tree of the cluster sidebar, so each is listed once, under "Gateway API".

## Fixes

- BackendTLSPolicy and XBackendTrafficPolicy read their status from `status.ancestors`: an accepted policy is now shown as Accepted, and the Overview no longer counts every policy as Unknown. Both details panels show their ancestors with their conditions.
- The HTTPRoute details show a rule's retry (`attempts`, `codes`, `backoff`), and header and query parameter matches as `name=value (type)`, as the GRPCRoute details do.
- The Gateway details show the frontend CA certificate links instead of `[object Object]`, and the certificate badges of Gateway and ListenerSet listeners are spaced apart.
- The BackendTLSPolicy details show the hostname, the well-known CA certificates and the subject alt names in a "Validation" section.
- No more React key warnings in the HTTPRoute and Gateway details.
- The model types take their optional fields from the kubebuilder markers of Gateway API v1.6.3.

## What's Changed

- Migrate to the Freelens v2 extension API by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/89
- Adapt the features to the Freelens v2 extension API and document the port by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/95
- Make HTTPRoute hostnames clickable by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/97, based on https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/81 by @drybalka-s
- Fix duplicate and missing React keys in the HTTPRoute and Gateway details by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/98
- Space the certificate badges and re-render pages opened before the CRDs load by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/100
- Register the Gateway API models in customResources by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/108
- Add XBackend and link backend references by their group by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/111
- Register details panels with the typed helper of the extension API by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/113
- Take the optional fields of the model types from the kubebuilder markers by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/114
- Fix mismodeled fields, reference links and policy status found in #111 and #114 by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/116
- Link the remaining references through ReferenceLink and show the core group as - by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/118
- Adopt the template changes of 2026-10-15 by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/119
- Run the integration tests against Freelens dev over CDP by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/127
- Update Biome to 2.5.15 and run biome migrate on the Renovate branch by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/102
- Dependency and toolchain updates by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/73, https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/80, https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/91, https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/92, https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/93, https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/94, https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/103, https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/105, https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/106, https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/109, https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/124, https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/pull/126

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-gateway-api-extension/compare/v0.2.2...v1.0.0
